title: Machine Learning in Drug Discovery: A Review

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Machine Learning in Drug Discovery: A Review》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】This review provides the feasible literature on drug discovery through ML tools and techniques that are enforced in every phase of drug development to accelerate the research process and deduce the risk and expenditure in clinical trials.
